scope: Preserve sparse interleaved DXF LWPOLYLINE vertex widths, bulges and identifiers without changing the public data-class or vtable layout; keep existing complete grouped-coordinate compatibility.
authority: Autodesk LWPOLYLINE DXF documentation lists group 10/20 as vertex coordinates and 40/41/42 as optional per-vertex start width, end width and bulge; group 91 is the vertex identifier: https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2017/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-748FC305-F3F2-4F74-825A-61F04D757A50.htm. ezdxf 1.4.5 independently serializes and reads these optional fields in the group-10 vertex that precedes them.
problem: The writer omits zero optional fields, but the reader previously assigned each optional group by its occurrence ordinal. A nonzero width or bulge only on the second vertex was assigned to the first, and an identifier only on the third was assigned to the first. The generated ASCII and binary controls both failed before the change.
change: In standard interleaved records bind each optional field to the latest group-10 vertex; reject duplicates on that vertex. If coordinate arrays are detected as grouped before optional fields, preserve ordinal binding for complete optional arrays; refuse partially populated grouped arrays because their per-vertex association is ambiguous. Refuse a switch from interleaved optional fields to grouped coordinates. Two parser mode bits are stored in unused high bits of the existing private X counter; masked comparisons preserve the existing 1,000,000-vertex bound, and existing copy/assignment/reset paths clear the counter array. No class member or vtable is added.

validation.fast: The existing --lwpolyline-point-component-order selector passes for ASCII and binary: sparse first/middle/last values, complete grouped compatibility, grouped-sparse/mixed/duplicate refusal before callback and same-reader retry, parsed grouped/sparse copy and assignment, late group 90, following LINE, invalid-output sentinel/caller preservation and corrected same-writer retry.
validation.independent: ezdxf 1.4.5 entity serialization authored a minimal AC1027 ASCII and binary drawing with middle-only widths and bulge, last-only bulge and a following LINE. Both ezdxf and the libdxfrw callback probe report the exact same vertex fields and LINE; both reads complete successfully. A separate full ezdxf document reached matching callbacks but returned overall read failure from unrelated content; this observation does not qualify full-document import.
validation.tools: tools/audit_dxf_sparse_lwpolyline.py authors/verifies both scratch inputs; compile tools/probe_dxf_sparse_lwpolyline.cpp against the built library to inspect callbacks. No DXF fixtures are committed.

limits: Grouped sparse optional arrays lack explicit vertex delimiters and are intentionally refused rather than guessed. Separate missing-Y validation remains open and is not addressed by this change.
